checks.scope: Only BRIEF-6.md Part C: 2 bases, 16 ridges, 16 existing peaks and 16 pines. References and approved art are comparison sources, not review targets.
checks.calibration: Good enough to ship beside the approved art. All required composites were inspected at native 1x and exact nearest-neighbour 4x. Each of the 48 sprites was also inspected individually at exact 8x on a checker background; each base was inspected in four complete 144x144 quadrants at exact 8x, plus its wrapped junction.
checks.prior_review: SHA-256 comparison with critic-r6C-1-audit.json: only mountains-base and mountains@winter-base changed. All 48 previously passed peaks, ridges and pines are byte-identical. Their passes are retained; fresh visual checks found no concrete defect requiring reversal.
checks.references: Compared with reference/current-fantasy-mountains, current-fantasy-mountains@winter, current-fantasy-hills, current-fantasy-treeline_forest, current-fantasy-treeline_conifer_forest, current-grass/current-plains and their winter counterparts. The old full-coverage mountain atlas is a material/scale reference, not a target for its egg-crate arrangement.
checks.approved_art: Compared with out/ fantasy/wuxia/modern markers, representative approved round-2 farmland/city/industry/suburb tiles, summer/winter paddies, the grass/plains summer/winter bases, and all 32 summer/winter grass/plains details. The cool slate rock, muted grey-green ground, dark needles and blue-white snow fit the approved material/value range. No palette-clash rejection.
checks.technical: All 50 requested files exist at exact sizes. Both bases are opaque. All alpha values are 0 or 255; each sprite has one 8-connected visible component. No exact RGBA duplicates. Enlarged visual checks found crisp pixel clusters without blur, smooth antialiasing, detached fringe pixels or export halos. See critic-r6C-2-audit.json.
checks.lighting: Upper-left rock facets and foliage carry the light; right-facing planes and lower branch tiers stay dark. Snow rests on upper ledges and branches. No reversed light direction.
checks.seasonal_consistency: Winter preserves the summer forms and enough exposed rock/needles to retain relief. No blank white replacements or inconsistent missing winter variants.
checks.specific_brief_problems: Checked egg-crate repetition and repeated crowns in the mountain/forest composites. Distinct peak heights and joined ridge shoulders avoid the old uniform peak array; pine crowns vary in width, lean and branch tiers. Swiss-cheese craters, classical ruins, cyberpunk grids and flat orange autumn are outside Part C and receive no verdict here.
checks.preservation: Every PNG in out/ has the same SHA-256 before and after this review. No out/ file was written.

checks.tiling: Both complete 3x3 fields inspected at 1x and 4x, with centered four-tile wrap junctions at 8x. No hard horizontal/vertical seam, border band, square grid or conspicuous tile-sized landmark repeat. Small motifs can be located again by deliberate matching, as in any repeated texture, but the field reads continuously at the shipping scale.
checks.summer_repair: The previously rejected long upper-right shelf and broad lower-left ledge are gone. Shorter, low-contrast rock clusters and broken moss/scree marks no longer organize the field into obvious paired landmark rows. Small lit stones remain readable; scattered pixels read as scree rather than high-contrast static.
checks.winter_repair: The previously rejected large dark shelf fronts are replaced by short, lighter exposed-rock patches and small snow caps. Their contrast and size do not dominate the 3x3 field. Blue shadow patches retain surface movement, while visible grey rock keeps winter from becoming blank.
checks.ground_and_style: Summer is grey-green with sparse olive tufts, no brown floor. Winter shares the blue-white snow range of the approved grass/plains. The adjacency/forest composites read as plausible foothills next to both terrains. Complete 8x quadrant checks show discrete palette steps and readable top-left shading.

checks.placement_and_shape: 144x96 joined chains with 2-4 summits, shared shoulders/saddles, low tapered ends and feet reaching the bottom. Indices 0-1 are tall, 2-5 medium and 6-7 low foothills in both seasons.
checks.range: Inspected at 1x and 4x with the prescribed 96px horizontal and 40px vertical staggered spacing, plus explicit 48px-overlap pairs. Overlaps produce connected range silhouettes; no rectangular sprite background, detached peak stamps or malformed lateral join. Ground channels below low foothills are compatible with their required low height.
checks.pixel_quality_and_variety: All 16 inspected individually at 8x. Varied summit layouts and heights remain distinguishable; no near-duplicate rejection. Rock planes stay legible and snow follows the same relief. No new concrete defect overturns the prior pass.

checks.lattice: All eight variants per season inspected in the fallback lattice at 1x and 4x and individually at 8x. Large asymmetric peaks, pointed spires, mesas and low outcrops remain distinct. The lattice is a placement stress test; these are narrow-spot fillers beside the joined ridge ranges, as Part C specifies.
checks.egg_crate: No uniform repeated summit/crown mass comparable to the old atlas. Height/width variation and broad versus narrow silhouettes break that reading. No new concrete defect justifies reversing the prior pass.
checks.edges_and_placement: 96x96 with feet centered near the bottom; last occupied row 93. The small transparent foot margin does not make them float over the base. Dark contours are intentional opaque outlines, not a fringe or alpha halo. Snow retains rock planes and summit identity.

checks.random_8x2: Inspected both seasons at 1x and 4x on a literal randomized 8-column by 2-row one-cell field, each variant present twice. No square backing, cell-edge seam or stamped cell frame.
checks.forest: Inspected both dense forests and mixed terrain/forest transitions at 1x and 4x. Small pines remain legible among one another and beside full-size forest trees. Winter transition includes the named summer-green conifer reference for height comparison only; the winter dense-forest test uses actual winter pines throughout.
checks.scale_placement_and_crowns: 48x48 exports; occupied heights 22-26px versus roughly mid-30px reference forest trees, close to the requested two-thirds. Trunks reach row 47 at bottom center. Narrow, broad, leaning and irregular crowns remain distinguishable. No identical or near-duplicate crown rejection.
checks.winter_and_pixel_quality: All 16 inspected individually at 8x. Snow follows branch tiers, with needles and trunks exposed. Crisp foliage clusters, upper-left highlights, no fringe/halo, muddy silhouette or blank winter. No concrete new defect overturns the prior pass.
